entries.name: pressroom-stories
entries.description: Use when planning a story or its angle, planning a series of stories, or writing one edition of a newsletter around a story. Not for building scroll movement in code.

entries.name: pressroom-scroll
entries.description: Use when deciding what moves while a reader scrolls a story, or implementing that movement with GSAP ScrollTrigger or with CSS scroll timelines only.

entries.name: pressroom-desk
entries.description: Use when reading, editing or converting an existing manuscript file, or checking the factual claims of a draft against its sources. Not for planning a new story.
